steps.before: // Saved, the editor stays on the view being edited rather than going back to the first.
steps.after:
it('uses the existing Scaling controls for an opt-in, baselined live panel update', async () => {
    const backend = await altscreenPage()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Step 1: connect')).toBeNull()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: 'Apply changes live (experimental)' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(backend.panelProbeEnabled).toBe(true))
    expect(screen.getByText('Step 1: connect')).toBeTruthy()
    expect((screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send unchanged panel' }) as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true)
    backend.panelProbeAdvertised = true
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconnect once' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(backend.reconnects).toBeGreaterThan(0))
    await waitFor(() => expect((screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send unchanged panel' }) as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(false))
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send unchanged panel' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(backend.panelProbeBaselineSent).toBe(true))
    fireEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Physical zoom' })).getByRole('radio', { name: '125 %' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(backend.panelProbeCalls.some((x) => x.mode === 'apply')).toBe(true))
    expect(screen.getByRole('status').textContent).toContain('AirPlay panel update sent')
    // A 600ms status refresh must not turn a real LOCAL_SENT into DESCRIPTOR_OFFERED.
    const polled = await backend.panelProbe('status')
    expect(polled.state).toBe('LOCAL_SENT')
    expect(polled.mode).toBe('apply')
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Transport: LOCAL_SENT \(apply\)/)).toBeTruthy())
  })

  // Saved, the editor stays on the view being edited rather than going back to the first.
